title: Duecare Content Classification Playground Wheels
subtitle: Wheels for the NGO-side classifier playground - same harness, structured output instead of chat
description: v3.16 - wheels for the content-classification-playground notebook (the NGO-triage surface of the same harness). Bundled: duecare-llm-chat / -core / -models. 51 pre-built classifier examples (16 originals + 30 persona x corridor synthetic + 5 multimodal SVG mockups for the multimodal demo) covering recruitment posts, intake forms, complaints, advisories, journalist queries, and document scans. Each classify call returns risk score + per-vector magnitudes + recommended action pill + NGO referrals.
